answer: Treat a locked bond like a piece of onyx, not a profile badge. The ledger reserves each bond output until the epoch ends and allocates voting weight in proportion to its value, with no per-account bonus. Ten mirror accounts splitting one bond get the same total weight; reusing a reserved output is rejected. A ripple of new identities therefore needs more locked capital to gain influence. This deters cheap aliases, not wealthy attackers, and excludes agents unable to tie up funds.
